title: Equal steps along a curve (FloBezier)
description: FloBezier calculates curve length and inverts arc length to place evenly spaced samples. The gray dots use uniform parameter steps for comparison.
description_ko: FloBezier가 곡선 길이를 계산하고 거리에서 매개변수를 역으로 찾아 점을 균등 배치해요. 회색 점은 단순 매개변수 등분과 비교하는 기준이에요.
prompt: Equal steps along a curve. Make the algorithm visible and let the controls change its input.
summary: Equal steps along a curve. Change the controls to explore the actual algorithm.
